$comment: COMMITTED STATE — the published URL surface. Read the URL contract in README before editing.
`editions` is keyed by edition path: `<slug>-<year>` for owner editions (served at
https://stagetimes.app/<slug>-<year>/) and `fan/<slug>-<year>` for fan editions (served at
https://stagetimes.app/fan/<slug>-<year>/). The namespace is declared in the edition YAML and
recorded here at first publish; the build refuses a YAML whose namespace disagrees, and refuses
to run if an edition recorded here has no YAML that builds to its path.
`stages` records every stage slug that has ever been served under that path. The build APPENDS
to this list and never removes. If a slug listed here is missing from the YAML the build refuses
to run, because that URL is still being polled by every subscriber who ever tapped it.
`listed` is the owner's approval for the homepage — always a human edit, never set by the build.
`pinned` (optional) puts a listed edition first on the homepage's coming shelf, ahead of the date order. A hand edit.
`blocked` takes an edition down: its feeds keep serving, empty, and its page says it was removed.
Setting it is the one-line takedown edit (docs/takedown-runbook.md); unblocking is a revert.
`publishedAt` is the revision stamp for this publish. Bump it whenever you change a data file;
it becomes DTSTAMP / LAST-MODIFIED on every event the build touches and `lastUpdated` in feeds.json.
It exists so the build never reads the wall clock — output must be byte-identical across runs.
